card.$description: Grouped cards in settings, both page styles: diagonal-inset readings 25.6pt (Privacy and Security) and 25.6pt (Chat Folders) in both themes. Plus or minus 2 pt.

bubble.$description: Message bubble corner away from the tail: 15.4pt dark, 17.1pt light. Plus or minus 2 pt.

iconTile.$description: Settings icon tile: 8.5pt on a 30 pt tile.

menu.$description: Context and pull-down menus (iOS 26 glass): 29.0pt dark, 30.7pt light.

sheet.$description: Top corners of a sheet (attachment sheet): 35.8pt.

capsule.$description: Fully round ends: the accent button (25.6pt on a 50 pt button), search fields (22.2pt on 44 pt), the tab bar (30.7pt on 64 pt), folder chips, the segmented control, glass nav buttons and the ADD pill.

base.$description: Measured gaps land on multiples of 4 pt within a pixel or two.

xs.$description: Gap between a row title and its subtitle.

sm.$description: Gap between folder chips and inside the selected tab pill.

md.$description: Gap between a row's icon tile or avatar and its text column.

lg.$description: Screen margin: grouped cards and the accent button start 16 pt from the screen edge (the box is measured from its first full pixel); row text inside a card sits 16 pt in.

xl.$description: Gap between grouped cards with no header between them (Settings root).

screenMargin.$description: Left and right margin of cards, the search field, the chip bar and the accent button.

row.$description: One-line grouped row (Privacy and Security), divider to divider.

rowTwoLine.$description: Grouped row with a subtitle (Notifications), divider to divider.

rowChat.$description: Chat list row: 60 pt avatar, title, two preview lines, time and pin. The same in both themes.

navButton.$description: Round glass back and action buttons: 44pt wide, 45pt tall dark, 46pt wide light, rim included.

chipBar.$description: Height of the glass bar holding the folder chips.

height.$description: Floating glass tab bar (Contacts, Calls, Chats, Settings).

width.$description: Tab bar width: it floats with about 20 pt each side.
Segmented control in the Calls nav bar (All / Missed).

button.$description: Full-width accent button (Add Device): 357x50.5pt dark, 357x50pt light.

pill.$description: Small accent pill in a row (ADD): 58.5x27.5pt.

iconTile.$description: Settings icon tile: 31pt including a pixel of anti-aliasing at each end.

avatarChat.$description: Chat list avatar (a circle; forum groups use a rounded square of the same size).

avatarList.$description: Calls list avatar (41pt); contacts read 38pt, anti-aliasing included.

width.$description: Send button inside the composer: a pill 40x34pt.

touchTarget.$description: Nav buttons, rows, chips and the tab pills are 36 pt or more tall; the 44 pt target is the platform rule, met by rows and nav buttons. The ADD pill (27 pt) sits inside a 72 pt row.

hairline.$description: Dividers between rows: one device pixel at 2x, with one pixel of anti-aliasing beside it.

base.$description: Not determinable from pixels. The letterforms match the iOS system face (SF Pro) closely; use the platform font.

regular.$description: Row titles, subtitles, previews, bubble text, menu items. Judged by stroke width, not measured.

medium.$description: Tab labels, folder chips and segment labels. Judged by stroke width.

semibold.$description: Navigation titles, chat titles, the accent button label, the profile name. Judged by stroke width.

profileName.$description: The owner's name on the Settings root, read from the ascender of a lowercase k, which sits a little above cap height. Cap-height readings: 27pt.

navTitle.$description: Navigation titles (Notifications, Chats, Contacts) and the accent button label. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

body.$description: Settings and list row titles, menu items. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

bubble.$description: Message text in a bubble (Appearance preview). Cap-height readings: 16pt.

chatTitle.$description: Chat list row titles. Cap-height readings: 15pt.

subheadline.$description: Row subtitles, chat previews (two lines), folder chips, segment labels. Cap-height readings: 15pt.

quote.$description: A link preview's description inside a bubble. Cap-height readings: 14pt.

footnote.$description: Footnotes under cards and section headers (upper case). Cap-height readings: 12pt.

caption.$description: Tab bar labels and the time inside a bubble. Cap-height readings: 10pt.

notTokenised: iOS 26 glass (nav buttons, the tab bar, the chip bar, the segmented control, menus, the composer): blur and refraction come from the system material
Gradients: outgoing bubbles in dark, icon tiles and initials avatars are gradients; each token is one reading along it
Chat wallpapers: a photo or pattern chosen per chat or theme; the dark captures show the owner's photo, the light ones Telegram's pattern
Continuous (squircle) corners: DTCG has no value for corner smoothing
Line heights of one-line labels: only multi-line blocks were measured
